title: Track the accepted architecture program as tasks
body:
Outcome: every slice of the accepted architecture program is a task with Outcome, Why, Proof and Scope and its order as `after`; the roadmap ranks them first; ADR 0014 records the operator order of 2026-11-10.
Why: the operator accepted the program (inbox 2026-11-10T09:03:22Z); delivery needs tracked slices.
Proof: `krn task ready` lists the first wave; `npm run fast` passes the roadmap and task checks.
Scope: tasks/, docs/program/roadmap.md, docs/adr/0014-operator-decisions-2026-10-23.md.
